descriptions.text: The AST token exploit was caused by a flawed transfer logic within the AST token's smart contract that interacted incorrectly with PancakeSwap's liquidity removal mechanism and the skimfunction. Specifically, when liquidity was removed from the AST-USDT PancakeSwap pair, the AST token contract mistakenly decreased the AST balance of the PancakeSwap pair and burned tokens instead of increasing the user's balance. Vulnerable code snippet: Attack tx: https://bscscan.com/tx/0x80dd9362d211722b578af72d551f0a68e0dc1b1e077805353970b2f65e793927 Analysis: https://olympix.substack.com/p/25m-moby-trade-exploit
According to monitoring by the SlowMist security team, AST was allegedly attacked on BSC.

On January 21, 2025, the AST token on BNB Chain was exploited due to flawed transfer logic during liquidity removal, allowing an attacker to manipulate AMM reserves and drain approximately $64,700 in USDT from the PancakeSwap pool. A logic flaw in the AST token's _transfer function handling liquidity removal led to a double decrement of the pool's AST balance without crediting the user, allowing the attacker to manipulate AMM reserves and extract excessive USDT.
